name: Pan-Seared Macadamia-Crusted Mahi-Mahi with Coconut Rice (Pirate Night)
brandOrRestaurant: Disney Wonder, Magic & Treasure · Pirate Night Menu
whyItWorks: The flaky white mahi-mahi and jasmine/coconut rice are 9/10 flare-safe, but the crushed macadamia nut crust is mechanically abrasive.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Ask your server for the Mahi-Mahi pan-seared plain without the macadamia nut crust (or scrape the nut crust off completely) over coconut/white rice.
